<document id="support-complaints">
Making a complaint
If you're unhappy with something we've done, tell us. You can make a formal complaint at any time.

## How to complain

Message support in the app and say you'd like to make a formal complaint. Tell us what happened and what you'd like us to do. Support will pass it to our Complaints team.

## What happens next

- We acknowledge your complaint within 2 business days.
- We send a final response within 15 business days.

If we need more time, for example because we're waiting on another bank, we'll tell you why and when to expect an answer.

## Our response

The final response explains what we found, what we'll do, and your options if you're still unhappy, including where you can take your complaint outside Tallowbrook.

## Legal matters

If your message involves legal action or a regulator, support passes it straight to the Complaints team.

Making a complaint never affects how we treat your account.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.
</document>
<document id="transfer-limits-basic">
Transfer limits on Basic
These are the transfer and deposit limits on the Basic plan.

| Limit | Amount |
|---|---|
| ACH transfers out, per day | $2,500 |
| ACH transfers out, per calendar month | $10,000 |
| BrookPay, per day | $1,000 |
| Domestic wires, per day | $5,000 |
| Mobile check deposits, per day | $1,000 |
| Cash deposits at stores, per day | $1,000 |

Daily limits reset at midnight Eastern Time. The monthly limit resets on the first day of each calendar month.

## Incoming transfers

There's no limit on money coming in by ACH, wire, direct deposit or BrookPay.

## New devices

For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, BrookPay and external transfers are capped at $500.

## Need more?

Limits are set by plan. Support can't raise them, even for one transfer. Changing plan is the only way to get higher limits.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
What changed in the March 2026 fee update
We updated our fees on March 1, 2026. Here's everything that changed and what stayed the same.

## What changed

- **Plus monthly fee:** from $4.00 to $5.00.
- **Plus foreign transaction fee:** from 1.5% to 1%.
- **Out-of-network ATM fee on Basic and Plus:** from $2.00 to $2.50 per withdrawal.
- **Plus free out-of-network withdrawals:** from 2 to 3 a month.

## What stayed the same

Basic is still free. Premium is still $15.00 a month with no ATM or foreign transaction fees. Card replacement, wire and cash deposit fees didn't change on any plan.

## Why we made these changes

Out-of-network ATM operators raised what they charge us, and we moved part of that cost into the fee. We lowered the Plus foreign transaction fee at the same time, so Plus members who travel pay less overall.

If the new Plus price doesn't work for you, you can move to Basic in the app. The change takes effect on your next billing date.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
</documents>
